description: WHM scoped private configuration. Never log input or returned configuration values, including raw mismatch payloads.

notes.text: Available in cPanel and WHM 86 and later. Scope names and returned string-valued configuration maps are private data. The source marks this retrieval x-readonly=false, so use form POST.
Client policy: send one request without automatic retry or rollback. Optional null arguments are omitted; accepted explicit zero and empty strings retain their supplied values.

notes.text: Available in cPanel and WHM 86 and later. Creates or updates scoped configuration and returns the full string-valued map. Supply either pre-serialized json text or key/value arguments: upstream says json cannot be combined with key or value. The client forwards supplied arguments without inventing mutual-exclusion validation and form-encodes JSON text exactly once; it does not accept a PHP object or send a JSON request body. Omitted optional arguments have no documented default. Scope, key, value, JSON text and returned private configuration are sensitive.
Client policy: send one request without automatic retry or rollback. Optional null arguments are omitted; accepted explicit zero and empty strings retain their supplied values.
